question: On one fixed post-scalar substrate, does the identity-safe package-order grammar causally restore Duskblade Afterimage complementarity while preserving an equally supported feasible package set?
method: One mechanism-blocked CRN discovery. Every package receives the same 64 policy and seed identities and a complete packageOrder-on none/A/B/AB target/control rectangle. Afterimage alone receives the complete off rectangle because prior equal-cohort evidence identified it as the failed action-order bottleneck. The other packages receive shared matched off/on AB interference anchors; their missing off cells are added only when a frozen anchor gate measures decision-valued interference.

structuralCandidate.substrateBoundary: The prior scalar candidate and family remain closed. These exact content and scalar settings are a fixed mechanism substrate because three packages cleared on them and the fourth exposed a measured action-order bottleneck; no alternative scalar cell is selected or compared.
structuralCandidate.singleCandidateAuthority: Only this substrate plus the exact identity-safe binary grammar may advance from this protocol.

immutableAdmittedAshPackage.use: Immutable scientific admission and reproduction evidence only. Do not reconstruct or rerun either exhausted research path.

admissionSet.successSet: Both Dusk packages and at least one equally evaluated supplemental Ash package clear at packageOrder 1. Together with immutable hand-size-payoff, this is the minimum two-package-per-aspect local causal set.

scorelinePayoff.role: Fixed substrate value; not varied and not aliased with Afterimage payoff.

afterimagePayoff.role: Fixed substrate value; not varied and not aliased with Scoreline payoff.

producerPresence.intervention: Replace the fixed producer slot with the registered producer when present, otherwise the registered neutral filler.

consumerPresence.intervention: Replace the fixed consumer slot with the registered consumer when present, otherwise the registered neutral filler.

aspect.intervention: Run the identical deck, policy and seed in the target aspect and other-aspect control.

packageOrder.intervention: Use the identity-safe registered action-order grammar at 1 and its exact frozen null at 0.

package.blocking: Package is a mechanism block with its own deck and response; no pooled package main effect is estimated.

designMatrix.packageOrderOn: All four packages receive none/A/B/AB in both aspects.
designMatrix.afterimageOrderOff: Afterimage receives none/A/B/AB in both aspects, supporting the full packageOrder x producer x consumer causal contrast.
designMatrix.otherOrderOffAnchors: The other three packages initially receive AB only in both aspects. These anchors support only matched AB endpoint, outcome, fault and duration movement; they do not support an off-setting complementarity claim.
designMatrix.optionalExpansion: For each non-Afterimage package whose frozen AB interference gate fires, add its off-setting none/A/B cells in both aspects on the same 64 identities, completing rather than changing its rectangle.
designMatrix.deckIdentity: Every arm has exactly ten cards. Non-intervened slots, enemy, unlocks, policy and seed are identical within every supported contrast.
designMatrix.aliasStructure: The on-setting none/A/B/AB cells are reused once for package complementarity and any completed structure interaction. Afterimage is fully crossed by design. A non-Afterimage off AB anchor is not aliased to missing off arms and cannot support a structure interaction unless deterministic expansion completes that package. Fixed payoff, rarity, Ward and acquisition substrate values are not causal factors in this experiment.

cohort.commonRandomNumbers: For a given index and seed, every package receives the same on-setting target/control and four arms; every packageOrder contrast reuses those exact identities and no selected package receives a different cohort.
cohort.independence: Root 548 and seeds 346128-346191 are disjoint from all roots and seed ranges used by the prior identity, first-look, held-out and exact-panel evidence.

anchors.primaryFailureAnchor: Afterimage packageOrder 0 exactly repeats the failed Q2/W0 mechanism under the new common cohort.
anchors.sharedInterference: Every other package receives matched target/control AB cells at packageOrder 0 and 1 before any optional expansion.
anchors.otherAspect: Every package and supported arm is evaluated in its target aspect and the other-aspect control.
anchors.reliability: Every supported cell reports outcomes, stalls/errors and duration on the same identities.

estimands.conditionalProducerEffect: At packageOrder 1, consumer-card response AB minus B within package and aspect.
estimands.producerConsumerInteraction: At packageOrder 1, consumer-card response AB minus A minus B plus none within package and aspect.
estimands.targetMinusControlInteraction: At packageOrder 1, target-aspect interaction minus matched other-aspect interaction.
estimands.afterimageStructuralGain: For each identity, packageOrder 1 minus 0 of the Afterimage target-minus-control producer-consumer interaction.
estimands.mechanismWitness: A target-aspect AB row has positive interaction and registered producer application plus consumer use in card-level event metrics.
estimands.duration: For target-aspect blocks where all arms win, AB turns minus the best none/A/B duration.
estimands.interferenceAnchor: For each non-Afterimage package, packageOrder 1 minus 0 of the target-minus-control AB card response, standardised by pooled target AB response scale, plus matched outcome, fault and duration movement.

estimator.unit: The frozen policy-index and research-seed identity is the paired causal unit.
estimator.standardisation: Package conditional and interaction contrasts use the population standard deviation of all four target-aspect responses. Interference anchors use the pooled off/on target-AB response standard deviation. Structural gains and duration remain in raw response units.
estimator.bootstrap: Exactly 5000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples with a fresh random.Random(421) stream per estimand.
estimator.multiplicity: No package, response, threshold, cohort, arm, expansion rule or bootstrap seed may be added or changed after the first observation.

gates.conditionalEffect: Lower 95% bound of standardised target AB-minus-B is at least 0.25.
gates.interaction: Lower 95% bound of standardised target AB-A-B+none is at least 0.25.
gates.aspectSeparation: Lower 95% bound of raw target-minus-control interaction is greater than zero.
gates.afterimageCausalRescue: Afterimage clears all on-setting package gates and the lower 95% bound of its raw packageOrder structural gain is greater than zero.
gates.reliability: Every simulated row is stall/error-free, AB adds no fault, and no target duration block is missing.
gates.duration: Upper 95% bound of AB-minus-best-single duration is at most 0.25 turns.

interferenceGate.expandWhen: Expand a non-Afterimage package if the matched AB endpoint-movement interval is wholly at or beyond plus or minus 0.25 SD, the duration-movement interval is wholly at or beyond plus or minus 0.25 turns, or any matched outcome/fault identity changes.
interferenceGate.decisionValue: A fired gate means the shared structural grammar moved a previously admitted package enough that the missing off arms can distinguish broad AB movement from a producer-consumer interaction. A quiet anchor gives no authority for that unsupported interaction and spends no rows.

decisionRules.success: Both Dusk packages and at least one supplemental Ash package clear every on-setting package gate, and Afterimage's structural-gain lower bound is greater than zero. Freeze exactly this one structural candidate for independent held-out confirmation.
decisionRules.futility: A required Dusk package decisively fails, too many supplemental Ash packages decisively fail to meet the minimum, Afterimage decisively fails, or the Afterimage structural-gain upper bound is not greater than zero. Close packageOrder and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Success is not met without a registered decisive failure, or execution reaches an immutable-input, incomplete-design, cache, engine, harness, row-cap or wall-cap fault. Record inconclusive at the cap and do not rerun or extend.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze at most the one exact structural candidate for an independently preregistered held-out complementarity and whole-run confirmation. This is not detector admission, product promotion or protected-seed authority.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close this package-order grammar and continue structurally inside issue #421 without selecting another scalar cell.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Stop at decision boundary 3. Do not add rows, alter the grammar or rerun.

stoppingRule: Execute the 2944-row first look once, compute all on package gates and shared anchors, add only deterministically triggered 384-row completion blocks, then take exactly one frozen decision boundary. No candidate or threshold changes are allowed.
deterministicOwnership: post_v38_package_order_discovery.py alone constructs rows, invokes simulation and cache, fits every estimand, applies expansion and stop rules and records the decision with zero model-context tokens.

methodBoundary.ml: Deferred. The measured repertoire bottleneck exists, but the deterministic structural grammar is the cheaper justified method.
methodBoundary.adaptiveTuning: Alternative scalar cells, grammar levels, package-specific cohorts, promising-cell extensions and V39-style candidate tuning are forbidden.
